harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blacklisted usb-storage on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false), rebuilt initramfs, and confirmed modprobe now refuses to load the module. Confirmed the module was already unloaded and stayed unloaded. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, triggered systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified the blacklist file and blocked modprobe behavior post-reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: usb_storage not loaded, no blacklist config
Wrote /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf with blacklist and install /bin/false directives
Verified module already unloaded (no-op unload)
Ran update-initramfs -u so blacklist applies at boot
Verified modprobe usb-storage fails immediately after config
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime baseline
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 (single node, acknowledged before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving actual restart
Re-verified blacklist file persisted and modprobe still blocked post-reboot

evidence.summary: Blacklist config written, initramfs updated, modprobe usb-storage fails with Invalid argument

evidence.requirement: usb-storage blocked from loading after reboot (persistence)
evidence.summary: After reboot, blacklist file still present and modprobe usb-storage still fails, module still absent from lsmod
Captured boot_id 242af11e..., uptime, module absence, and blacklist file presence before reboot
systemctl reboot scheduled via backgrounded setsid so ack returned before disconnect

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving restart
evidence.summary: Connection timed out during reboot, then reconnection showed boot_id changed to ba406a82... with new uptime start time

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required config/state
evidence.summary: Blacklist file intact and modprobe still blocked after the node came back up
